en-US.guidance: Canonical English source. Direct, compact arcade copy with sentence casing and consistent product terminology.
en-US.notes: Freeze and approve English before approving translations.

en-GB.guidance: Natural British English where regional copy differs; preserve the compact arcade voice.

en-AU.guidance: Natural Australian English where regional copy differs; avoid forced slang.

en-CA.guidance: Natural Canadian English where regional copy differs; preserve the compact arcade voice.

de-DE.guidance: Friendly informal du, idiomatic German, correct cases, and German sentence casing rather than English title casing.

nl-NL.guidance: Friendly informal Dutch with natural compounds and sentence casing; avoid literal English arcade phrasing.

it.guidance: Energetic informal Italian with idiomatic racing vocabulary and sentence casing.

fr-FR.guidance: Friendly informal tu for France, idiomatic arcade vocabulary, French punctuation, and sentence casing.

fr-CA.guidance: Genuinely Canadian French, consistently formal vous, Canadian vocabulary where natural, French punctuation, and sentence casing.
fr-CA.notes: Must not be a mechanical clone of fr-FR.

es-ES.guidance: Friendly informal European Spanish with coche, adelantamiento, partida, and natural sentence casing.

es-MX.guidance: Friendly Mexican Spanish with carro, rebase, partida, and natural local idiom; do not inherit European Spanish UI pixels.
es-MX.notes: New complete in-app and independent source-capture locale.

ca.guidance: Valencian Meridional throughout: teua/seua, hui, este/esta, ací, appropriate -ix forms, rellotge, and avançament.
ca.notes: Reject Central Catalan and Spanish leakage.

ja.guidance: Compact, inviting Japanese game copy with consistent politeness and natural arcade terminology.

ko.guidance: Natural Korean game copy with consistent 해요-style politeness and compact UI phrasing.

pt-BR.guidance: Friendly Brazilian Portuguese with consistent você forms and Brazilian racing vocabulary.

pt-PT.guidance: European Portuguese using neutral third-person forms without explicit você/vocês; use European vocabulary and orthography.
pt-PT.notes: Reject Brazilian terms such as mouse where rato is intended and mixed address forms.

zh-Hant.guidance: Traditional Chinese throughout, compact Taiwan-friendly game phrasing, and no Simplified Chinese character leakage.

zh-Hans.guidance: Simplified Chinese throughout with compact, natural arcade phrasing and no Traditional character leakage.

tr.guidance: Natural informal Turkish, dotted/dotless-I correctness, stable terminology, and locale-appropriate casing.

pl.guidance: Natural Polish with correct inflection and plurals, stable terminology, and sentence casing rather than English title casing.
